question: If 40\% of 10\% of (1)/(3) of a number is 477, find the number.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

40% × 10% × (1/3) = (2/5 × 1/10 × 1/3) = 1/75

So, (1/75) of number = 477

⇒ Number = 477 × 75

⇒ = 35775

**∴ Answer = 35775**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

40% of 10% of (1/3) of a number = 477

**Formula used:**

Percentage = Fraction × Number

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let number = x

⇒ 40% of 10% of (1/3)x = 477

⇒ (40/100) × (10/100) × (1/3)x = 477

⇒ (2/5 × 1/10 × 1/3)x = 477

⇒ (1/75)x = 477

⇒ x = 477 × 75

⇒ x = 35775

**∴ The correct answer is 35775.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage to Fraction

40% = 2/5, 10% = 1/10

Successive Multiplication

Apply percentages step by step as multiplication

Equation Formation

Convert statement into algebraic equation

Inverse Operation

Multiply by reciprocal to find original number
